name: c-event-calendar-1
title: Event calendar with all views and live settings
label: All Views
description: Event calendar with all views and live settings

guidance.bestFor: A feature tour whose tabbed Settings popover drives view options, time grid, drag behavior, 6 languages and 5 time zones
agentNotes: Drag to create is on through `selectSlot`, yet nothing handles the drawn range, so a drag over empty time only selects it
`renderEventContent` keys its custom chips to the sample ids `design-review` and `client-call`; every other event gets the built in chip
Right to left for `ar` comes from `dir` on the wrapper div, not from `locale` or `i18n`, so carry that attribute with the calendar

whenNotToUse.when: A form that opens on a day or an item click to create, edit and delete

name: c-event-calendar-2
title: Event calendar with resource view for room bookings
label: Room Bookings
description: Event calendar with resource view for room bookings

guidance.bestFor: Hotel rooms as columns from 8:00 to 20:00, holding stays, check-outs and housekeeping colored by a status legend
agentNotes: Chip colors are copied from `STATUS` into each booking's `color` when built, so changing `status` later also needs a new `color`
`addBooking` always books noon to 1 PM in room `r101` with no overlap check, so repeated clicks double book that hour

whenNotToUse.when: Bookings made by dragging across free time, with double booking refused
Bookings typed into a form that also edits or deletes the one you click

name: c-event-calendar-3
title: Event calendar with create and edit dialog
label: Event Form Dialog
description: Month calendar with event CRUD in one dialog: open from an empty day, an event, or Add event, commit via apiRef. Title, color, start, duration, all-day fields. ReUI EventCalendar, Nav, Toolbar; shadcn Dialog, Field, Select, Switch. Scheduling apps.

guidance.bestFor: A single form dialog that opens blank on an empty day or the toolbar, and edits or deletes whatever you click
agentNotes: `openCreate` keeps only the day of a clicked slot and `seedCreate` starts every draft at 9:00, even after a 2 PM click in week view
`openEdit` reads only `getHours` of the start, so saving an item dragged to 9:15 moves it back to 9:00

whenNotToUse.when: New bookings drawn by dragging across empty time rather than typed into a form

name: c-event-calendar-4
title: Event calendar with custom event chips
label: Custom Event Chips
description: Event calendar with custom event chips

guidance.bestFor: Project bars spanning several days in a Monday first month, led by a track icon, with hover tooltips and a legend
agentNotes: A `category` that is not a key of `CATEGORY` throws in `renderChip` and `renderTooltip`; an event with none falls back to the built in chip
`addProject` drops a 3 day design bar and `addMilestone` a 1 day product bar starting today, both with fixed titles

whenNotToUse.when: Bars that open a form on click to rename, retime or delete them
Timed meetings across week and day time grids with a view switcher

guidance.bestFor: A consultant's day from 9:00 to 18:00 where dragging over free time books a slot and overlapping draws are refused
agentNotes: `bookSlot` inserts a New appointment placeholder the moment a drag ends; open your booking form or call your API there instead
`canBook` only checks new draws, so moving or resizing an appointment onto another one is never refused
Client photos load from `randomuser.me` URLs in `buildAppointments`; swap them for your own images or drop `AvatarImage`

whenNotToUse.when: Appointments typed into a dialog with title, color, start and duration fields
Several rooms or staff shown side by side as columns of one day
